answer: The platen drops on the forme with a single pull, and the pull must be even or the impression is weak. Paper flax stitcher type bond is the dropping: a bond flax stitchers lodge after stitching room checks. The island is the first drop, made at the press; the nebula is the last, made before the day is done, and the tide is the impression itself, weak as water. A cheat must drop 29 false platens and pull 29 false bars.
